subject: Exec alignment + technical deep dive — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmehealth.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Apr 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — exec + technical deep dive

Hi Alex / Maya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Summary:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood Inference for latency-sensitive clinical summarization workloads.
- Primary evaluation criteria: 99th percentile latency, on-prem/private deployment options, SOC 2 / audit evidence, and predictable pricing for production traffic.

Immediate next steps we agreed on:
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) so we can confirm business and procurement stakeholders — target: 30 minute alignment with Connor + Marissa.
2) Technical deep dive / demo with Rafael (SE) to walk through runtime, KV caching, and VPC/private deployment considerations — target: 60 minutes.
3) Share a mutual action plan (MAP) and one-pager — attached.

Availability:
- Exec alignment windows (30m): Wed 4/12 10:00–11:30 PT or Thu 4/13 14:00–16:00 PT
- Technical deep dive (60m): Thu 4/13 09:00–12:00 PT or Fri 4/14 13:00–16:00 PT

Can you confirm which exec alignment window works for your team and whether we should include your CTO, Daniel Park, on that call? If exec alignment is confirmed, Rafael and I will tee up the technical deep dive for the following week.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (MAP has milestones, success metrics, and a proposed timeline).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed 4/12 10:00 PT should work for a 30 minute exec alignment. I will confirm with Daniel but he tentatively said he can join.

Maya and I would like Rafael on the exec call as well so the high level architecture questions can be addressed in real time. For the technical deep dive, Thu 4/13 morning looks good.

Can you send a calendar invite and include the MAP?

Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — exec + technical deep dive

Alex / Marissa —

Appreciate the quick follow-up. Happy to join both the exec alignment and the technical deep dive. A couple quick notes to make the demo useful for your infra team:

Pre-demo checklist (so I focus the session):
- Typical sequence lengths and 99th percentile latency SLOs you care about (sample traces welcome)
- Expected concurrent requests / peak qps during nightly batch vs daytime interactive
- Any on-prem / VPC constraints or specific KMS/HSM requirements

Suggested agenda for the technical deep dive (60m):
- 10m: goals and success metrics
- 20m: runtime architecture (KV cache, batching, kernel selection, quantization options)
- 20m: deployment patterns (hosted vs dedicated vs private/VPC), networking and KMS notes
- 10m: Q&A and next steps + MAP review

I've updated the MAP with a proposed technical validation checklist (see attached mutual-action-plan.xlsx). If you can drop a couple sample traces or a short description of traffic patterns, I’ll tailor the demo and prepare a short perf baseline to share.

Thanks — looking forward to the calls.

Rafael Mendes
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0123

Alex / Maya —

Thanks — calendar invite sent for Exec alignment (30m): Wed 4/12 10:00–10:30 PT. I've included Daniel Park (CTO) as requested and Rafael will join to take any architecture questions.

Marissa: I included the MAP link in the invite and attached the one-pager. Rafael — I scheduled the technical deep dive for Thu 4/13 09:30–10:30 PT per Alex's availability; if that doesn't work I'll move it to Fri 4/14 13:30–14:30 PT.

Please confirm and I’ll lock both invites.

Connor O'Brien
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0177
